20 | Stasis Barrier | 1 target | 1 rnd/lvl | 100' | F

50 | Slippery Barrier True | 50'x50' | 1 min/lvl | 100' | U

# Descriptions
@@ 1
Allows target to see all Mana Barriers (any spell effect from this list)
within 100'. Without benefit of this spell, the caster can only see Mana
Barriers that he creates.
@@ 2
Creates a shield of force in front of the caster that adds 25 to his defense.
The shield will move with the caster.
@@ 3
Creates an invisible barrier 10'x10'x1'that slow anyone who tries to move
through it by 35%. It will also modify any attack made through it by -35.
@@ 4
Creates a shield of mana behind the caster that negates any bonuses for flank
or rear attack made on him.
@@ 5
Encases the Caster in a mana Shield that will absorb 20 concussion hits damage
before collapsing. Any concussion hits absorbed in this manner are not
inflicted upon the caster. Any criticals scored against the caster are reduced
by one level unless the concussion damage breaks the shield (treat an 'A'
critical as an 'A' critical modified by -25).
@@ 6
Creates a cage of mana around a target. target cannot move more than 1 foot
from his current location or make any attacks. All melee attacks against (or
by) the target suffer a special modification of -50 and missile attacks suffer
a penalty of -25. The target can break out of this cage by making a Very Hard
static maneuver (modified by triple Strength).
@@ 7
As Hindrance Barrier I, excepts movement reduction is 50% and penalty if -50.
@@ 8
Covers an area in a thin layer of mana that is very slippery. All attempts to
move across the area require a hard moving maneuver to avoid splipping and
falling (Very Hard if moving on an incline).
@@ 9
Creates a mana barrier around a single, inanimate object (that has no more
than 1.5 time the caster's mass) that makes the object difficult to hold on to
or move. Any attempt to manipulate the object requires a hard static maneuver
(modified by triple strength). if the object is a weapon, failing this
maneuver results in a fumble.
@@ 10
As Personal Shield I, except the shield can take 40 hits before collapsing.
@@ 11
Creates a wall of mana through which nothing will pass. It can withstand 100
concussion hits damage before collapsing.
@@ 12
Creates an invisible field that slows anyone trying to move through it by 75%.
All attacks made through the field are at -75.
@@ 13
Wraps the target in a mana barrier that is very slippery on the exterior.
Every time the target moves, he must make a Very Hard moving maneuver to stay
on his feet.
@@ 14
As Slippery Barrier I, except an Extremely Hard maneuver must be made to move
while on the field (sheer Folly if on an incline).
@@ 15
As Personal Shield I, except the shield can take 60 hits before collapsing and
any criticals are reduced by two unless the concussion damage breaks the
shield (treat a 'B' critical as an 'A' critical modified by -25 and an 'A'
critical as an 'A' critical modified by -50).
@@ 16
As Mana Wall I, except it can take 200 concussion hits before collapsing.
@@ 17
Wraps a normal missile (arrow, bolt, sling stone, etc.) in a field of mana
that improves it flight. Any attack using this missile receive one quarter
normal range penalties.
@@ 18
Renders a Mana Wall permeable to one specific type of thing (gasses, metal,
stone, living organic material etc.; designated when this spells is cast). The
designated material may pass through the Mana Walls.
@@ 19
As Mana Wall I, except it can withstand 300 concussion hits damage before
collapsing.
@@ 20
Encases a target in a mana barrier that completely immobilizes the target.
It's position will not change in relation to its surroundings (i.e., a flying
bird caught in a stasis field will not fall to the ground). All attacks
against the target suffer a penalty of -100. All normal bodily functions of
the target are halted while the spell is in effect (but the target suffers no
ill effects from this). To the target, it will appear as though no time passed
between when this spell took effect and when it ends.
@@ 30
As Personal Shield I, excepts that it can absorb 100 hits before collapsing.
@@ 50
As Slippery Barrier I, except an Absurd maneuver would be required to move
while on the field (and movement on an incline becomes impossible with some
assistance to lower the difficulty).
